content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (LD, high severity).**

- **Responsive clause:** § 7.6 (p0032) is the document's only liquidated-damages/penalty mechanic, and it runs *against* us: USD 25,000 per day for "any delay in providing a dependency" — no cure period, no materiality threshold, no aggregate cap.
- **Other locations checked:** § 7.3 (dispute withholding — benefits us, not flagged), § 21.1 / § 21.3 (mutual cap and Excluded Claims — does not neutralise an uncapped-per-day trigger for minor delays), § 27.3 ("without penalty" — a Customer right, compliant), and no early-termination-fee or minimum-fee-on-termination clause exists.
- **Target level:** preferred, since deleting the sole Customer-payable LD requires no collateral rewrites and nothing cross-references § 7.6.
- **Operative change:** one surgical replace of the per-day formula with "Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement," leaving Vendor to its ordinary damages remedies subject to the § 21.1 cap; the fallback (sole early-termination fee capped at three months' fees) is offered in the comment.
